description: Central Province - Pawn Broders Statute No. 04 of 2014 of the Central Province Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a new provincial statute (Pawn Brokers Statute No. 04 of 2014) that establishes a regulatory framework for pawnbroker businesses in the Central Province. It creates new legal requirements for registration, licensing, and operation of pawnbroker businesses, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on statutory provisions, regulatory compliance, and legal procedures, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
